name: GalaxyCon San Jose
blurb: A three-day San Jose festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, cosplayers and fan groups at the McEnery Convention Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON SAN JOSE ... AUGUST 20-22, 2027 ... We look forward to seeing you August 20-22, 2027 at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center'

notes: Succeeds SiliCon/Silicon Valley Comic Con at the same venue per the discovery note; confirmed directly from the con's own site (not from that note). Guest cards show only name + attendance days, so Known for is left blank throughout. Card #20's visible caption literally reads 'Pro Wrestlers Coming Soon' (a category placeholder, even though its image file is oddly named after wrestler Gangrel) so it is skipped rather than assumed confirmed. Two Authentication cards (JSA, Agents of Slabs) are vendor services, not individual guests, and are excluded, matching galaxycon-raleigh. A few guest names (e.g. Marv Wolfman, Bob Layton) sit behind image files named for other people (reused/mislabeled assets on GalaxyCon's own site) — the displayed name text is what's used in each case. Cover uses the San Jose wordmark logo; the homepage's other images are the shared 11-city promo, a generic galaxy background, a cosplay cutout prop, a fan's photo-op snapshot, and a ticket-sale banner, none of which are edition-specific key art. Verify pass (2026-10-05): current -- re-fetching the live guest page shows 'Coming Soon' is a fixed banner heading GalaxyCon prints above every category on this template (Celebrities, Voice Actors, Featured Creators, Cosplay, even Cancellations), with real confirmed names and specific scheduled appearance days listed under each one, matching the same template behaviour already verified on the Animate! Orlando page; it is not a sign these particular picks are unannounced, so the lineup stands. Refute attempt (2026-10-05): refuted -> none-yet -- that 'current' call checked only that 'Coming Soon' is a template banner and stopped there; a full per-guest check of the cached image filenames shows every single one of the 32 picks is explicitly year-tagged, and every tag is '2026-GC-...' or '2025-GC-...' (e.g. Hayden Christensen, Cheech Marin, Mark Bagley, Don Bluth = 2026; Joe Wos, Guy Hutchinson, Nancy Wu = 2025) -- not one candidate on the page carries a 2027 tag, so 'Coming Soon' here is in fact accurate and the entire grid is last cycle's roster still live on the page; guests set to none-yet and lineup removed.
